pick.headline: Epic Defends Competitive Practices, Agrees to Let AI Read Records Hospitals Already Own
pick.take: The largest EHR vendor says it is not anticompetitive, and as proof will allow artificial intelligence to access the charts. Access to patient data is now a feature to be granted, like a premium tier. Clinicians have spent years asking for a search bar that works. The machines get the API first.
